chunks: All praise is for Allah, from whose view one sky does not conceal another sky, nor one earth another earth.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that no sky or earth conceals Allah?
ai.summary: This opening praise from the *Khutbah* of the Elective Committee (Khutbah al-Hum) establishes the theological foundation for Ali ibn Abi Talib’s caliphate by affirming Allah’s absolute omnipresence and omniscience, unobscured by the physical layers of the cosmos. In Shia exegesis, this declaration underscores the divine legitimacy of the Imamate, as the Caliph serves as the visible manifestation of God’s authority on earth, just as God’s knowledge penetrates all hidden realms. It sets a tone of spiritual sovereignty, linking cosmic order with political and spiritual leadership.

en.sayed-ali-raza: from whose view one sky does not conceal another sky nor one earth another earth.
